summary: End-to-end testing of Bulk Account Upload feature (backend + frontend). Created pytest suite with 11 cases covering preview (xlsx/docx/rejected-txt), auth & role-gating, create-accounts flow (with parent login verification, auto-gen email, duplicate skip, parent update, create_students=false, empty-records validation), and regressions. All 11 backend tests PASS (100%). UI flow tested as admin dwain@tcis.demo: /admin/bulk-upload route, sidebar nav, file upload -> preview -> create -> result view all work flawlessly. Admin + existing parent logins regressed OK.

issues: React hydration console warnings: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' / '<select>'. These are not from BulkUploadPage itself (its select+option structure is clean); they originate from the shared layout. Pre-existing, does not affect functionality but should be cleaned up.

critical_code_review_comments: bulk_upload.py uses `default_passwords` literal strings in response body — OK since those are intentional defaults, but consider moving to settings/config for long-term flexibility.
parse_excel header-detection heuristic relies on text_count >= len(vals)//2; if a header has more numeric-looking fields it could misbehave — consider requiring first row as header explicitly.
create-accounts endpoint does not validate per-record input with Pydantic; it trusts dict.get() — low risk because only management roles call it, but Pydantic model would be cleaner.
When create_students=false but create_parents=true and a student with same name doesn't exist, the new parent's children_ids is empty []. Expected behavior but worth documenting.
Duplicate detection is by exact (case-insensitive) name match — two students with identical names from different families would collide. Consider adding admission_number or DOB to the dedup key.
